assumptions.maker_fee_bps: 1.5 bps maker rate is the unverified scheduler/fees.go constant (issue 1726 measured no maker fill); no rebate is assumed
assumptions.min_order_value_usd: USD 10 minimum for risk-increasing quotes is an unverified venue rule; reduce-only orders below it are assumed accepted
assumptions.slippage_reserve_bps: 5 bps reserve equals the paper SlippagePct constant; it is a reserve, not a measured cost
assumptions.stop_reference: stops trigger on recorded trades and fill against recorded depth less the slippage reserve
assumptions.taker_fee_bps: 4.5 bps taker rate is the scheduler/fees.go constant, reported as a conservative upper bound by the private issue 1726 evidence
